name: Perplexity Search API Starter Pack 🌐
description_md:
# What You Get

- Plug-and-play n8n workflow: four ready HTTP nodes (raw Search, Grounded Chat, Academic allowlist, Structured JSON output) with timing notes for demos—hit “Execute” and see the API in action instantly.

- Multi-Agent Research Synthesizer: a coordinator + three specialized agents (Academic, Practical, Innovation) wired to Perplexity tools with buffer memory and OpenAI model configs—drop in a query and get a unified synthesis.

- Field-tested API docs (September ’25): endpoint cheatsheets, domain/recency filtering patterns, structured outputs, pricing/tiers, and n8n request templates that mirror the included workflows.

- Bonus: Domain filtering blueprints (allowlist/denylist), JSON schema example for clean parsing, and troubleshooting notes for SDK quirks—perfect for vibe-coded apps and no-code flows.If you want even more AI goodies, join my Early AI-dopters Community — you won’t regret it 😉 https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
